subject: Request: promotional surge credits for Founders Sprint cohort
messages:
From: Elena Kuznetsova <elena@launchsprint.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: promotional surge credits for Founders Sprint cohort

Hi Marcus / Laura,

Quick note from LaunchSprint — our next Founders Sprint cohort kicks off next Tuesday (demo day in 6 weeks) and a handful of teams are planning to do heavy live demos that will spike inference usage (video Q&A agents + code gen). We ran numbers and expect ~80k–120k extra tokens over the next 30 days if we provision a short-term uplift.

Is there a way to get an expedited, one-time promotional allocation to cover the surge? Ideally something we can activate immediately for 45–60 days. We have a short mutual action plan and can share milestone deliverables (demo dates + feature list).

Why this matters: these demos are being showcased to a set of angel investors and platform partners — if we can avoid throttling, teams will keep Redwood as the default provider going forward.

Simpler asks:
- Can Redwood provision a short-term credit uplift (one-time)?
- What information do you need from us to expedite?
- Any short-term agreement we need to sign?

Attached: founders-sprint-milestones.xlsx (skeleton timeline).

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Kuznetsova
Head of Partnerships, LaunchSprint
[Attachment: founders-sprint-milestones.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Kuznetsova <elena@launchsprint.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: promotional surge credits for Founders Sprint cohort

Hi Elena — thanks for the context and the timeline. We can often do a one-time promotional allocation for partner cohorts; the typical process is:

1) Quick usage estimate (tokens/day or expected peak)
2) Confirmation of the cohort window (start/end)
3) Sign a short MPA (mutual participation agreement) or an amendment to your existing partnership agreement

If you can reply with the expected peak/day and confirm 45 vs 60 days, I can move this to approvals. Provisioning can be provisional (temporary allocation) while Legal prepares a short MPA — that usually speeds things up.

Next steps I can take immediately if you confirm:
- Provision a provisional 100k token uplift under deal id DB-1192 pending signed MPA
- Share the MPA template (attached) and a DocuSign link for signatures
- Loop in billing to update expiry parameters

Attaching the MPA template for your review. If you want a different figure than 100k, tell me the number and reasoning and I’ll include that in the approval note.

Best,
Marcus
Marcus Lin | Strategic Partnerships 
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: MPA-template.pdf (PDF, 54KB)]

Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: promotional surge credits for Founders Sprint cohort

Marcus — reviewed. Approve one-time promotional uplift as follows: 

- Allocation: 120,000 token credit (one-time)
- Window: 60 days from activation
- Conditions: activation contingent on signed MPA and confirmation of peak usage estimates from LaunchSprint
- Expiry: unused credit will expire at end of window; no rollover

Please set deal id to DB-1192 and notify billing (Neha on cc) to set the metric flags for a 60-day expiry. Marcus, you have explicit approval to provision the provisional allocation while Legal finalizes the short MPA.

Internal note: mark this as partner co-marketing credit; do not convert to refunds. If LaunchSprint asks for a longer term, escalate to me with usage reports.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference
